title: PPR_RAD_Korea v9.10: code for a wildlife-borne peste des petits ruminants incursion model of the Korean Peninsula
description: Model code, driver script, environment specification, public inputs of the external test and a runnable synthetic test for the article 'Wildlife-Borne Incursion of Peste des Petits Ruminants into the Republic of Korea, Conditional on Water-Deer Competence: A Reaction–Advection–Diffusion Scenario Analysis' (Microorganisms).
